    The category of degree-labelled objects #

    For a linear category with graded Hom spaces, the objects (X,s) have morphisms to (Y,t) given by the degree s-t part of Hom(X,Y). This is the shift convention of the graded interval proof. Restricting the objects to projectives and a finite interval gives its finite category algebra.
